facts.statement: FRL works on accessibility and mobility solutions.
Service categories include ramps, stair lifts, vertical platform lifts, vehicle lifts, installation and service/repair; this does not promise acceptance of a specific job.
For vertical platform lift and ramp/commercial projects only, the proposed area is Tampa/Melbourne south to the Keys, including Key West, subject to project review.
Projects outside that corridor may be considered individually, with no guaranteed service.
Intake categories are residential, builder/general contractor, architect/specification planning, commercial accessibility and service/repair.
Residential intake normally includes contact/project information and site images; the demo will describe this only and collect no real details or photos.
Service/repair requires team qualification and acceptance, with no dispatch, timing or parts promise.
